publicationPolicy.scope: Eleven retained English and Spanish town market-research route pairs
publicationPolicy.treasuryRule: Render only the exact single-district row from the finalized 2025 NJ Treasury Average Residential Statistics file and preserve its published labels.
publicationPolicy.currentYearRule: Link the 2026 file for current-year context only; do not infer or render missing 2026 sales or tax fields.
publicationPolicy.realtorRule: Link the NJ Realtors public county-report portal and its publication page; do not copy member-only municipality tables.
publicationPolicy.propertyRule: A property-specific CMA requires current comparable properties and facts about the subject property.
publicationPolicy.fairHousingRule: Do not rank or steer by protected characteristics, demographic proxies, institutions, or subjective place labels.

sharedSources.publisher: New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Taxation
sharedSources.title: Property Tax Statistics
sharedSources.use: Locate the Division of Taxation's annual Average Residential Statistics files and read their year-specific labels.
sharedSources.limit: Tax and assessment statistics are not a listing-service report, appraisal, or property-specific valuation.

sharedSources.publisher: New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Taxation
sharedSources.title: 2025 Average Residential Statistics
sharedSources.use: Supply the finalized district row using the exact published columns: # of Line Items, Avg Assessment, Avg Tax Bill, # of Sales, and Avg Sales Price.
sharedSources.limit: The published figures are district-level 2025 values with average labels; they are not a current listing price or a property-specific CMA.

sharedSources.publisher: New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Taxation
sharedSources.title: 2026 Average Residential Statistics
sharedSources.use: Provide a direct link to the current-year file so readers can review what the State has published.
sharedSources.limit: At review time the file did not expose the complete tax and sales columns used below; do not infer missing 2026 values or label 2025 values as 2026.

sharedSources.title: 10K Market Data
sharedSources.use: Confirm the official route to public state and county market reports and the distinction between public county reports and member municipality reports.
sharedSources.limit: A county report does not establish a town result, and this site does not reproduce member-only municipality tables.

sharedSources.title: Public State and County Reports
sharedSources.use: Let readers select a county, exact reporting period, and available property category at the source.
sharedSources.limit: Selections and values change with the chosen geography, period, and category; no portal table is copied into these town pages.

sharedSources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Community Affairs
sharedSources.title: Housing Discrimination and Fair Housing
sharedSources.use: Provide a direct state resource for fair-housing rights and complaint information.
sharedSources.limit: This page is a public information resource and does not decide an individual legal matter.

reports.identityEn: Glen Ridge is in Essex County. The Treasury table publishes this tax-district row as GLEN RIDGE TWP, so the source name is preserved exactly here.
